lines: Hard Rock (Florida) prices: player shots on goal, the main line, over or under. No leg worse than -200.

The rule: Pinnacle (the sharpest book) moves its odds on a line by 2+ points of chance between two of our price checks, and Hard Rock quotes that same line on both checks with a price at or better than Pinnacle's fair price (Pinnacle's new chance with its own margin taken out). We bet the side Pinnacle moved toward.
Prices are checked at 1 PM ET and about 90, 45 and 20 minutes before each puck drop. A pick can come from the 90, 45 or 20 minute check. The price shown is frozen and is the one graded.
The book's price must be at least as good as Pinnacle's fair price after the move. It is being proven on the Record (started 2026-10-20).
A player listed Out or Doubtful is never picked. A player whose ice time dropped below 2 minutes in each of the last 3 games is skipped. Needs 10+ games of history.
A pick is pulled if he is ruled out or doubtful, or Hard Rock takes the line down. If the line moves after a pick is shown, it goes TOO LATE and still counts on the Record like any other pick.
One pick per player per market a night.
Graded after the game at the shown price, 1 unit flat. Overtime counts. Did not play = void.
New picks stop if the Record falls to -10 units.
